title: Finite lists of free abelian covariant representables
statement: Let $I$ be a small category. Define $R_i:I\to\mathrm{Ab}$ by $R_i(j)=\mathbf Z[\operatorname{Hom}_I(i,j)]$, with postcomposition on generators. The preadditive category $\mathcal F_I$ has objects finite lists $(i_1,\ldots,i_k)$, including $k=0$, and morphisms all natural transformations between the finite sums $\bigoplus_aR_{i_a}$. Its identities, composition, addition and zero are those of natural transformations. For $M:A\to B$, its $(b,a)$ coefficient is the element of $\mathbf Z[\operatorname{Hom}_I(B_b,A_a)]$ obtained by evaluating $\pi_bM\iota_a$ at the identity generator of $R_{A_a}(A_a)$.
